sent_to_model:
hey so I need help writing like an open letter to everyone, friends, neighbours, the school families, that people can forward on and pass around. there was a fire at my block of flats in Obs on Saturday night and my flat is basically gone. I'm ok, staying at my sister's in Rondebosch. my phone has been going mad since sat and I can't answer everyone one by one, I'm so tired. I want one proper letter that says I'm safe, what happened (short version, I don't want to relive it all), what I actually need and what I don't, and the fundraiser my friend Zinhle set up. ALSO people keep sending me some other 'fund' that is NOT ours so I need to warn people about that. it's going to all my friends and the school moms and random people who get it forwarded. my notes are below sorry they're messy

- fire started around 11:40pm Sat 7 Nov, ground floor flat (not mine), I'm on 2nd floor, flat 12
- Lindale Court on Station Rd Obs, 14 flats, everyone got out, 2 people treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home
- fire dept says probably an electrical fault, still investigating, I'm not going to guess
- my flat - smoke and water everywhere, ceiling came down in the lounge, landlord says nobody back in for at least 6 weeks
- Zinhle's BackaBuddy page is backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court, target R25 000, already at R11 400 this morning
- the fake one is a 'Thandi Fire Relief' page on some site plus a WhatsApp asking people to EFT to a Capitec account, that's not me, I've reported it
- school is Little Acorns Pre-Primary in Mowbray, I teach the Ladybirds (Grade 00, 4-5 yr olds)
- neighbour Uncle Faizel banged on every door on our floor in his vest and slippers, that's how I woke up
- grabbed my phone and Marmalade (my cat) and nothing else, Marmalade hid under the car for two hours after
- all the stuff I took home to laminate for the end of year concert is gone, 22 crowns and the kids' handprint banner
- one of my kids' moms dropped off a bag of clothes at my sister's at 7am Sunday without even knocking, just left it on the gate
- I hate asking for help, honestly feel weird about the fundraiser but Zinhle said shut up and accept it
- so grateful, people have been amazing, I've been crying at every message
- furniture can be replaced, Marmalade can't
- NEED - help with the deposit for a new place, school shoes/work clothes size 6 / size 34, and a laptop if anyone has an old one that works (all my lesson planning was on mine)
- DON'T NEED - more clothes in general (have too many already, will pass extras to the other flats), food (sister's freezer is full)
- for the parents - concert on 27 Nov is still happening, don't worry, Ladybirds will have crowns
- I'm back at school on Wednesday, please don't make a big thing of it in front of the kids
- reply to comments slowly, please don't be offended if I don't answer DMs

(About me: kindergarten teacher, 26, Cape Town, South Africa. Length: it should come to roughly 800-2,000 words.)

must_cover: Says the writer is safe and briefly explains the fire and temporary living situation.
Asks for help with a deposit for a new place, size 6 school shoes, size 34 work clothes and an old working laptop, and says that more general clothing and food are not needed.
Shares the legitimate fundraiser and warns that the other fund and EFT request are fake.
Reassures families the 27 November concert continues with Ladybirds’ crowns, gives the Wednesday school return, and asks adults not to make a fuss in front of the children.
Explains that replies to comments will be slow and some DMs may go unanswered, asking readers not to take this personally.

reference.kind: a model-written solution, used only to show the checks can be met
